state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done; Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. `whoami`, `read`, `modify`, `delete`, `rename`, `setPassword`, `changePassword`, `compare` and `Entry::isDeleted` owe nothing, perf included.

**Nine `Core\Ldap` features still owe everything.** `bun nv proofs --owed --limit 1000 | grep -i ldap` lists them: `Connection::authenticate`, `search`, `changes` and `add` (about, examples, hostile, perf, tests), `LdapError` (about, examples, hostile, tests), and the enums `ErrorKind`, `Tls`, `Scope` and `Ad\AccountType` (about, examples, tests). `bun nv proofs --gate` prints only its first 30 lines, so read the full list there and never the driver's one-line summary.

**The whole-roster check also counts features outside this goal.** Most of what `bun nv proofs --gate` names is `Core\Str` stale perf, `lang` and `Core\Db`. The check `dossier-the-whole-roster-owes-nothing-with-core-ldap` in `data/goals/ldap.json` cannot pass from `Core\Ldap` work alone.

**Two blocks reach `samba-ad`.** `[ldap.corp]` binds as the read-only `Reader` (`whoami` returns `u:EXAMPLE\Reader`) and is granted by directory to every `Ldap-*` tree. `[ldap.corp-accounts]` binds as `Administrator` and is granted only to the write proofs' directories and bench files, by a nested `[[app]] root` or `entry` in the root `nvs.toml`. `add` writes, so its proofs need `corp-accounts` grants beside the `modify` ones; `authenticate` binds on a fresh connection. An `[[app]] root` that names a missing directory fails every program with `E0605`. Check a draft with `bun nv proofs --run --id '<feature>' --show`.

**Samba stalls under parallel writes.** A write bench run beside a write attack can hit the block's 5 s timeout; `--record-perf --only <id>` alone succeeds. `read("")` returns the server's root entry, not `null`.

**Seeded facts a proof can print:** people are `CN=Anna Berg`, `CN=Ben Kohl`, `CN=Carla Diaz` and `CN=Dora Lind` under `OU=Company`, plus `CN=Reader`. Anna Berg and Carla Diaz are in `Sales`.

items.text: **`Core\Ldap\Connection::add` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): its row is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:456`; `tests/conformance/core/ldap-add-modify-delete-rename.nvst:4` takes `add` beside its `modify` and `delete` marker, and the proofs need `corp-accounts` grants beside the `modify` ones in the root `nvs.toml`. A `covers:` line added to a case with `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` moves its `case.nvs:<line>` down by one.

**`Core\Ldap\Connection::authenticate` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): its row is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:414`; `tests/conformance/core/ldap-authenticate.nvst:1` and its two siblings take a `// covers:` marker. A login needs a user with a known password, so its proofs add one under `corp-accounts` the way `setPassword`'s do.

**`Core\Ldap\Connection::search` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): its row is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:423`; it reads, so its proofs use `[ldap.corp]`, and `tests/conformance/core/ldap-read-and-search-take-a-dn.nvst:1` can take a second marker.

backlog: `changes` owes every proof — the group after this one (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`).
`LdapError`, `ErrorKind`, `Tls`, `Scope` and `Ad\AccountType` owe about, examples and tests (`data/proofs/policy.json` says what an enum owes).
The whole-roster check owes features outside `Core\Ldap`; whether `data/goals/ldap.json` should narrow it to `--group 'Core\Ldap'` is the goal record's question.
A non-leaf delete reports `$kind` `Protocol`; whether result 66 deserves a named kind is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs`'s `ERROR_KIND`.
